description.value:
You momentarily summon an army of powerful dragons that unleash annihilating blasts as they descend upon your location. These dragons act as one and collectively occupy the space of a Gargantuan creature. They have a fly Speed of 100 feet. The dragons are of the same magical tradition that you used to Cast this Spell.

Arrive Energy Annihilation The draconic legion breathes out two blasts of energy: a @Template[type:line|distance:120] and a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] that can't overlap. Each creature in either of the areas takes @Damage[10d8[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save. The dragons choose the damage type of each blast of energy depending on the tradition of dragons summoned. Arcane dragons can choose @Damage[10d8[force]|options:area-damage]{force} or @Damage[10d8[mental]|options:area-damage]{mental}, divine dragons can choose @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage]{fire} or @Damage[10d8[spirit]|options:area-damage]{spirit}, occult dragons can choose @Damage[10d8[mental]|options:area-damage]{mental} or @Damage[10d8[void]|options:area-damage]{void}, and primal dragons can choose @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage]{fire} or @Damage[10d8[poison]|options:area-damage]{poison}.

Depart Draconic Whirlwind The draconic legion strikes with fury, dealing all enemy creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] @Damage[9d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage (basic Reflex save).

duration.value: until the end of your next turn
